description.value: Iron Road Brewing is an award-winning craft brewery in Kamloops, BC, founded by two geologists who teamed up with an award-winning brewer to produce a rotating lineup of balanced, flavourful beers. The 60-person, family-friendly taproom is steps from Thompson Rivers University and serves food alongside the house-brewed lineup. Cyclists may catch a live band or watch the brewing process up close.
